messages:
Maria (CS): Heads-up — SentinelPilot account showing a sharp usage drop since last week. Renewal in ~45 days. 7d avg tokens/day down from 12.4k to 4.3k, active seats 12 -> 6. Need quick triage.

analytics-bot: Automated alert: customer_id=sentinelpilot metric=token_usage 7d_pct_change=-65.3% last_active=2026-03-10.

Devon (AE): @Maria (CS) I pinged procurement last week — they moved the champion to a vendor eval. I can loop in the exec sponsor. Do we have any specific win stories vs the competitor they're testing?

Anil (SE): I can run a quick health check and look for integration errors. Noticed a small spike in 5xx/504s in the logs earlier this month which could be scaring them off.

Maria (CS): Primary drivers look like stakeholder change + perceived cost on embeddings. Jess, can product surface a short comparison / cost breakdown and any short-term offers?

Jess (Product): We can do a 1-page cost/latency comparison vs LexaAI and a targeted 2-week burst credit or reserved burst to demonstrate perf/cost. Will need concrete usage slices (which endpoints, typical seq len).

Devon (AE): I'll schedule a sponsor call for Tue 10am PT. @Anil (SE) can you join an API deep-dive Wed? Maria can lead the renewal conversation.

Anil (SE): Wed 11am PT works. I'll bring a quick checklist to run during the call:
```
- verify API key rotation and quotas
- inspect request patterns for embeddings (batching?)
- check for 504 spikes and upstream timeouts
- enable prefix/KV cache where applicable
- sample request: curl -sS "https://api.redwood.com/v1/usage?org=sentinelpilot" |
```

Maria (CS): Action items: Devon schedule exec call, Anil run health check Wed and share findings, Jess produce one-pager by EOD Mon, Maria draft renewal options + pilot credit offer. I'll update the playbook and the customer notes.

ops-bot: Reminder: Renewal date in 45 days — ticket CS-4829 created and assigned to Maria (CS).

Maria (CS): Also capturing feedback requests from procurement: they want "billing clarity" and confirmation on feature parity for embeddings compared to LexaAI. I'll summarize after the sponsor call.
